feeds.title: Tilly and the Buttons
feeds.description: Covers gorgeous, easy-to-use sewing patterns and online workshops for the new wave of DIY dressmakers. Find jargon-busting instructions & photos showing each step. Also learn to sew your own clothes, sewing patterns, tips and tutorials for beginners.

feeds.title: Lladybird
feeds.description: Covers dressmaking exploits and pattern cutting pursuits, as well as important tips, tricks and techniques. Also tutorials for dress, skirt, jacket, coat garments & clothes fitting. Lauren is a native Nashvillian with a love for all things sewing-related.

feeds.title: Made By Rae Blog
feeds.description: I'm Rae! I design sewing tools that allow women to connect to their creativity by sewing clothing that is both beautiful and practical. I'm here to provide you with the inspiration and tools you need to help you turn your ideas into reality. I want you to feel how empowering it can be to make your own clothing.

feeds.title: The Dreamstress
feeds.description: I'm Leimomi Oakes, a costumier fashion and textile historian, former museum professional, potential Ph.D. student, sewing teacher, writer, and more. The Dreamstress website is a window into my world: my projects, new things I learn, things I know so well I can teach, the amazing places I live and the amazing places I visit, the wonderful people I am surrounded by, anything interesting that catches my fancy that I think might catch yours, and, of course, Felicity the cat.

feeds.title: Sew Tessuti Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1992 and with locations in Sydney and Melbourne, Tessuti Fabrics is home to the world's most beautiful designer fabrics. Here you will find Sewing Tips & Tutorials.

feeds.title: William Gee Blog
feeds.description: William Gee ltd was established in 1906, and is now the leading stockist and distributor of sewing/fashion supplies & haberdashery in the UK. Here you will find dressmaking techniques.

feeds.title: The Thrifty Stitcher Blog
feeds.description: Hello! Learn to sew with me Claire-Louise Hardie, The Sewing Producer for The Great British Sewing Bee. I'm a Professional Stitcher with a passion for teaching beginners to sew!

feeds.title: Diary of a Sewing Fanatic
feeds.description: Carolyn is a sewist, dressmaker, fabricaholic and creative fiber artist, who loves to sew and has made everything from her wedding outfit, to coats, her daughter's and grandchildren's clothing as well a couple of home dec items.

feeds.title: Ladulsatina
feeds.description: My name is Martina. I'm an Italian sewing blogger. I love to create my own dresses.I learn sewing in order to create my own dresses and accessories. This sewing blog was born to share my adventure (and misadventure), get suggestions and run into new people with whom sharing ideas and inspirations.

feeds.title: Nice dress! Thanks, I made it!!
feeds.description: Covers sewing patterns, handmade bags, domestic and vintage sewing machines. Linda, the author, is addicted to sewing. She wants to try everything, learn everything and talk about it with the readers.

feeds.title: KS_Sews
feeds.description: Sewing Addict. That about sums it up!! I love to sew and I love collecting fabric and patterns.

feeds.title: Lilacs & Lace
feeds.description: Chronicling my adventures in creativity. I adore sewing and knitting, mostly vintage or vintage-inspired patterns. I hope this blog will inspire others to create lovely and lasting garments that speak of a past era and yet remain timeless and elegant.

feeds.title: Sigrids Sewing Projects
feeds.description: Sigrid's blog 'Sigrid sewing, knitting' is a creative showcase of her sewing and knitting adventures—featuring detailed garment makes, pattern tutorials, digital drafting projects, and behind-the-scenes insights from her decades-long journey as an instructor and pattern designer.

feeds.title: So Very Jo
feeds.description: I have what I call crafters ADD. I can be a bit all over the place with my crafting/DIY love affair. My crafting journey began with jewelry making. I decided that I wanted to make beaded jewelry and went out and purchased a TON of beads and anything related to beading. Then I purchased a Silhouette Cameo and all bets were off. I can make ANYTHING with this machine. Well then came my real true love, sewing.

feeds.title: Curvy Sewing Collective
feeds.description: Covers sewing tutorials, challenges, by a group of curvy sewing bloggers intent on demystifying all things plus-sized and home sewing. Curvy Sewing Collective is on a mission to get more curvy women sewing, blogging, & feeling fabulous!

feeds.title: Amazing Women's World
feeds.description: This Blog provides Truly about Fashion Designing Tutorials integration with YouTube Videos, Creative Fashion Designer Wears for both Women and Children's,Design It Yourself(DIY). Professional Sewing Tutorials on Designer Blouses,Ghagra choli's, Lehengas, Frocks and Dress making and many more.

feeds.title: This Blog Is Not For You
feeds.description: Charlie shares her seamstress successes, and also her fashion fails, a lot of helpful tips and tricks, patterns and instructions along the way. Also covers tutorials to make your own handmade things.

feeds.title: A Dress A Day
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Erin McKean. I write A Dress A Day.

feeds.title: Erica Bunker
feeds.description: Covers fashion couture sewing, tailoring, coatmaking, DIY and more. Erica Bunker is a fashion sewing blogger who inspires the average home sewer how to look beyond outdated commercial pattern instructions, select fine fabrics and cultivate a luxurious home-sewn wardrobe inspired by luxury brands.

feeds.title: Male Pattern Boldness
feeds.description: Covers articles about sewing, style, fashion, fabric, and more! Peter is a native New Yorker and sewing fanatic, who makes all his clothes using vintage sewing machines and vintage patterns, in addition to sewing for private clients.

feeds.title: Jennifer Lauren Vintage
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Jen and I design fun modern sewing patterns. I take the extra time to guide you through building your own beautiful wardrobe piece by piece by giving clear, concise instructions with all sewing levels in mind. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced seamstress, my patterns and tutorials will help you through the steps of building a handmade wardrobe that is fun, bright, and uniquely you.

feeds.title: Sewing on the edge
feeds.description: Covers helpful sewing techniques written by a real-life serial sewist.

feeds.title: Sewing Like Mad
feeds.description: I am a formally trained seamstress. The goal with our education, besides being able to sew almost every type of garment, was to work closely with designers during their design process. When I moved to the US, all my sewing friends were back in Denmark and my new friends were not sewing so I started Sewing Like Mad as a way to connect with other sewing-interested folks and to share my knowledge.

feeds.title: Thanks! I made them!
feeds.description: A Dress making blog by Bianca S. Here you will find posts for sewing clothes, different sewing patterns and much more.

feeds.title: Sharon Sews
feeds.description: Sharon Sews is a blog of sewing clothes. Here you will find reviews of sewing projects, tutorials, inspiration and a bit of real life.

feeds.title: Self Assembly Required
feeds.description: I'm Emily, a self confessed sewing addict. I love designing and making clothes, pattern hacking and rambling on about fabric. This blog is all about sharing my love for sewing and all things crafty!

feeds.title: SunnyGal Studio Sewing
feeds.description: Beth, of SunnyGal Studio, a custom dressmaking and design studio. I create unique, custom fit clothes for my clients and a few new dresses for myself. I love to sew almost anything, formalwear, tailored jackets, children's clothes, vintage styles, and clothes for travel to sunny places. When I am not sewing I work in my garden and obsess about the weather.

feeds.title: The petite Cat » Sewing
feeds.description: A personal style blog where you can find all the pretty things I wear, make, or have my eyes on. | Portuguese style blogger based in the Netherlands.

feeds.title: Allie M Jackson
feeds.description: I'm Allie. In my free time, I love to sew. allie J. is my place to document my life, especially my sewing projects. I adore the styles of the 1950s and 60s, so expect to find lots of shift dresses and full skirts here. I sew from vintage and modern patterns, striving to create a vaguely-retro wardrobe that works with my real life.

feeds.title: Dress Design with Debby Black
feeds.description: Dress design blog by Debby Black - a fashion designer and author, specializing in couture, designing bridal and evening gowns, as well as elegant daywear.

feeds.title: The Avid Seamstress
feeds.description: Hello. We're The Avid Seamstress, a London based pattern company dedicated to helping modern women enjoy the art of sewing. The Avid Seamstress produces versatile & multi-functional sewing patterns to bring together a community of women that empower and inspire each other through sewing.

feeds.title: Clueless Seamstress
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Leigh. I'm a newbie seamstress in South Wales stumbling my way through teaching myself to sew. I blog here about my successes, failures and everything in between.

feeds.title: The Wardrobe Project
feeds.description: I'm Mady and I'm a self-taught seamstress and knitter. This is my journey towards a handmade wardrobe! I discovered the mind-blowing sewing blogosphere and I never stopped sewing since. Making things is my therapy and my goal is to one day have a wardrobe full of handmade clothes. I love learning new things and techniques, and sharing my passion with other lovely like-minded people out there.

feeds.title: The Tell Tale Tasha
feeds.description: Natasha, 26, is from the DC Metro area. Natasha started sewing in 2013 after losing a significant amount of weight. Instead of throwing out the majority of her wardrobe that no longer fit, she decided she would alter and transform what she already had. With two gifted sewing machines and internet tutorials, her basic alterations have transformed into an ever-growing love for sewing patterns.

feeds.title: The London Dressmakers Club
feeds.description: A place to contribute, exchange ideas and find further info on the LDC group on Meetup. Here you will find sewing dressmaking patterns tutorials blog dress, skirt, jacket, coat garments & clothes fitting.

feeds.title: The Itinerant Seamstress
feeds.description: I have four beautiful kids - two little girls and two littler boys. I began knitting while single, and dreamed of sewing my own clothes, but thought it was too hard. Then, while pregnant with my oldest daughter, I sewed a set of 12 cloth wipes. That was in 2009 and I haven't looked back.

feeds.title: The Dancing Dressmaker
feeds.description: A sewing adventure from a little corner of Wensleydale. Well hello!I'm Kate and you're most likely to find me making things, all the things, in a little village in Wensleydale. That is, of course, when I'm not running about after my fabulous little girl.

feeds.title: Dress Making and Designing
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from Dress Making and Designing.

feeds.title: DIY Clothes
feeds.description: Diy clothes is about sewing tutorials, refashions and patterns that I found searching a billion diy blogs. I was inspired from all those women and their creativity, so I decided to collect them here for everyone who is interested and enjoys making sewing projects.

feeds.title: Diana
feeds.description: This blog is to show my sewing projects with comments and/or short sewing lessons on particular aspects of garment constuctions.

feeds.title: Stitches and Seams
feeds.description: I'm Debbie Cook. I've sewn almost everything - home dec, quilting, gifts, lingerie & more, but sewing clothes for myself is what I really love and I sew most of my wardrobe because I have fun doing it and because it fits me better than anything I'd find in a store.

feeds.title: Dress Patternmaking Blog
feeds.description: Learn to make your own blocks, then make patterns using those blocks at Dress Pattern making. Find information on terminology, pattern making principles, how to draft elements such as collars and sleeves, and follow the step-by-step instructions for creating full patterns. All instructions are accompanied by images.

feeds.title: Sew Over It Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about various patterns for intermediate sewers and confident beginners, ideas to sew your own dress, stylish patterns that will make you feel amazing, gorgeous fabrics and more.

feeds.title: Sew Essential Blog
feeds.description: Covers sewing tips, tutorials, dressmaking patterns, sewing machines, fabrics, haberdashery and much more.

feeds.title: Closet Case Patterns
feeds.description: I'm a pattern designer, blogger, and sewing educator for the modern maker. I transform your imagination into step-by-step implementation that helps you build a wardrobe you love -- not one you're limited to buying off the rack. A sewing blog for the modern maker. Providing you with sewing patterns, tools & techniques to help you create a self-made wardrobe you can wear with pride.

feeds.title: Pauline Alice Blog
feeds.description: Pauline alice is also a personal sewing blog, depicting my journey as a new business owner, learning about new techniques, new makes and sewing tutorials.I learned to sew by myself when a teenager and when I arrived in Spain in 2011, I bought my first sewing machine. Since then, I've making all my wardrobe, from casual summer dresses to more spectacular costumes.

feeds.title: Trish Stitched
feeds.description: Trish is a handbag designer, blogger, and the petite seamstress behind Trish Stitched. Trish makes and sells bags on Etsy, and makes clothing for her under 5′ frame. Trish went to school for Fashion, Costume Design and Business and now sews in her little Hoboken, NJ studio and works on her parents' farm. She loves color, floral prints, and buttons.

feeds.title: oobop
feeds.description: I began sewing from a very young age when I used to sew pocket linings for pocket money. And so here I am. A gazillion years later. Still no time on hands (between 3 children and a full time career as a freelance graphic designer) but a determination to create that handmade wardrobe I always dreamt of. I'm currently in the process of learning some pattern cutting and hope to share not only some handmade dresses but some original designs and some insight as to what I learn along the way.

feeds.title: The G. G. Files
feeds.description: Gloria Glamont is a Toronto woman of a 'certain' age who writes women's fiction and business books. She is deeply interested in fashion, but mostly style, which as anyone knows is not the same thing.

feeds.title: Gwenstella Made Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Gwen. This a Singapore-based vintage style and handmade blog. Keep scrolling for vintage-inspired outfits, as well as sewing and other craft projects! This blog is all about my vintage style and sewing projects. Stay a little while and you might find something you like!

feeds.title: Lisa's Carolina
feeds.description: I sew my clothes. I love to quilt. But mostly I sew my clothes. This is a journal of my work.
